title: ChemDeduce: Benchmarking LLMs for Unknown Chemical Identification through Interactive Simulated Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2611.33848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in chemical knowledge and reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether they can solve problems whose answers must be discovered through experimentation. We investigate this question through Unknown Chemical Identification, where a model must actively design experiments, interpret observations, update hypotheses, and ultimately identify a hidden substance. We introduce ChemDeduce, an interactive evaluation framework for assessing LLMs through simulated experiments. ChemDeduce formulates chemical identification as a sequential decision process and provides a stateful simulated laboratory with explicit instrument and operational constraints, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation of iterative experimental reasoning. translated_title: ChemDeduce：通过交互式模拟实验对大语言模型进行未知化学物质识别能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在化学知识和推理方面已展现出强大的性能，但它们能否解决那些必须通过实验才能发现答案的问题仍不清楚。我们通过“未知化学物质识别”任务来研究这一问题，即模型必须主动设计实验、解读观测结果、更新假设，并最终识别出隐藏的物质。我们提出了ChemDeduce，一个通过模拟实验来评估大语言模型的交互式评估框架。ChemDeduce将化学物质识别表述为一个序贯决策过程，并提供了一个具有明确仪器和操作约束的有状态模拟实验室，从而实现对迭代实验推理能力的可扩展、可复现的评估。我们在200种化学物质上对八个前沿大语言模型进行了基准测试，产生了1600个模型-目标组合，并在三次独立重复实验中开展了4800个回合的评估，对识别能力进行了评测。
tldr: 该论文提出了ChemDeduce——一个将有状态模拟实验室中未知化学物质识别建模为序贯决策过程的交互式评估框架，首次系统性地测试了大语言模型通过主动设计实验、迭代推理来发现未知答案的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChemDeduce, an interactive evaluation framework that formulates unknown chemical identification as a sequential decision process within a stateful simulated laboratory, enabling the first systematic benchmark of LLMs' ability to discover answers through active experimentation and iterative reasoning.
